constraint: Research OS must not require creation of an additional active Scheduled Task while the existing non-prediction task remains enabled.

slot_3.responsibility: Market Research, Mechanics or Algebra by task shape; Red Team normally after specialist evidence; temporary Reproducer borrows this slot when promotion-relevant

slot_4.responsibility: reconcile artifacts, enforce gates, choose next decisive question, consolidate report

slot_5.responsibility: remain untouched by Research OS migration unless the user explicitly changes it

important_tradeoff.current_prediction_pattern: Four staggered prediction tasks collectively approximate one prediction run per hour.
important_tradeoff.full_four_lane_hourly_pattern: Four research task runs per hour, one per lane, would consume materially more Plus task/model allowance.
important_tradeoff.decision: Do not activate four-lane hourly execution until a canary measures useful unique evidence per run and usage impact.

canary_modes.description: Keep current approximate one-model-run-per-hour cadence; test six-domain context/routing inside existing transport first.
Use two genuinely independent discovery lanes only during a bounded shadow interval; leave specialist/director consolidation conservative.
Primary Scout + Recon Scout + dynamic Specialist/RedTeam/Repro + Director each operate as separate hourly task lanes.
canary_modes.activation_gate: Only after low-usage and dual-discovery canaries show enough incremental value.

reproducer_policy: Independent Reproducer never consumes a sixth active task slot; it temporarily borrows the dynamic specialist/red-team slot and is isolated by input contract.
